# Shared Gradle version table (issue #8988). Every Gradle reader that marks a
# version resolved (build.gradle, build.gradle.kts, libs.versions.toml) must
# agree with this table. Format: "<want><TAB><text>", want is "exact" or
# "not-exact". Text holds no whitespace or quote so a test can embed it in any
# Gradle notation. Source: Gradle "Declaring Versions and Ranges" and
# "Declaring Rich Versions" docs (prefix '+', latest.<status>, Maven-style
# ranges, the '!!' strict short-hand) and the artifact-only '@ext' notation.

exact	1.2.3
exact	1.2.3-rc1
exact	1.2.3-SNAPSHOT
exact	1.0.0.Final
exact	2.3.4-RC1
exact	5.0.0-M1
exact	1.2.3_beta
exact	33.0.0-jre
exact	31.1-jre
exact	1.0-latest
exact	latestRelease
exact	v1.2
not-exact	+
not-exact	1.+
not-exact	1.0.+
not-exact	1.3.+
not-exact	1.0+
not-exact	1.0.0+build.1
not-exact	latest.release

not-exact	latest.milestone
